overall_assessment: NHH generally preserves the main accordion sections, the displayed learning-outcome groups and labeled assessment values, though assessment logistics persist in both suspects and controls. All six empty flags are false alarms (Papers., Lectures., ECS508., Presentation., Attendance. and BED3), while both short flags identify pointer or test text and the sole leak flag identifies a real teaching boundary error in RET1. All five blob flags reflect source plans with one top-level substantive block, so the size alone is a false alarm for a failed split, although MAB4 has a missed pedagogy subsection and BUD5 and EBO4 embed teaching descriptions in their Topics prose.

findings.evidence:
Undervisningsopplegg

Forelesninger, seminar, oppgavekurs og innleveringsoppgaver på Canvas.
findings.description: RET1 has two Undervisningsopplegg blocks. The first is appended to learning_outcomes and the second supplies teaching_methods. The seminar appears only in the misplaced block. All actual outcome groups survive.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The NHH HTML reader sees the accordion heading but leaves the earlier standalone Undervisningsopplegg line inside the learning-outcome body as text.
findings.suggested_fix: In the NHH reader or .text_subheadings(), recognize the standalone Undervisningsopplegg line inside Læringsutbytte as a teaching_methods boundary. Keep distinct source statements in teaching_methods and collapse exact repeats.

findings.evidence:
Pedagogical Approach:

MAB4 adopts a problem-based, student-centric pedagogy, prioritizing the practical application of theoretical concepts through case studies and interactive discussions.
findings.description: MAB4 has an explicit pedagogy subsection inside Topics. Its teaching description is filed entirely under course_content and no teaching_methods row is emitted.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The NHH HTML reader classifies the outer Topics accordion and provides no inner boundary for the pedagogy subsection.
findings.suggested_fix: Recognize a standalone Pedagogical Approach label within NHH Topics as a teaching_methods opener, then return to course_content at Detailed Course Outline.

findings.evidence: Godkjent obligatorisk aktivitet fra SKL402 er et krav for å kunne gå opp til vurdering i dette emnet. SKL402 og BUS444N kan tas i samme semester.
findings.description: BUS444N prerequisites contain a concurrent SKL402 coursework approval gate, exam registration and withdrawal instructions, and degree-profile rules alongside a genuine recommended statistics and methods prerequisite. The SKL402 approval condition is absent from coursework_requirements.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The NHH reader sends the whole Krav til forkunnskaper block to prerequisites, and prerequisite cleanup does not recognize the mixed SKL402 block.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an NHH-scoped rule matching the explicit SKL402 approval-for-assessment sentence and its concurrent-enrolment qualification to coursework_requirements. Strip the SKL402 exam-registration, withdrawal and degree-profile paragraphs and retain the recommended subject knowledge.

findings.description: RET1 lists exam aids under Litteratur as well as under Hjelpemidler til eksamen. The dictionary permission, calculator and Category 2 aids block are filed as readings alongside the genuine textbook. The permitted-aids section already supplies exam aid information.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Litteratur accordion is mapped as a whole to reading_list, leaving the aid list under the source heading and partly duplicating assessment.
findings.suggested_fix: In RET1, recognize the aids list starting at the explicit dictionary permission and ending with the Category 2 list. Compare those items with the labeled assessment aids and retain any distinct permissions there. Keep the textbook entry in reading_list.

findings.evidence: The presentations will happen continuously throughout the course. Division of groups and dates for presentations will be done in January.
findings.description: Assessment retains presentation scheduling in ECS509, a term-paper deadline in ECN435, a relative deadline in ECS576, and an appeal rule in the EEU416 control. Standalone assignment release and deadline sentences in ECS509 are already removed. The surviving logistics are embedded in prose rather than an exam table.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The NHH rules in .logistics_sentences cover some stock release and submission sentences, but the remaining timing and appeal wordings escape those rules. Some deadlines share a sentence with the assessment design.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend NHH cleanup to the presentation-scheduling and standalone deadline and appeal variants observed here. For a relative deadline attached to the assessment form, remove only the scheduling clause and keep the assignment type, language, weights and any stated working time.

findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The pointer survives .keep_section_row() because its wording is absent from .placeholder_phrases.
